name: Entangle
description: Grasping plants fill a 20-foot square (a 20-foot cube zone, the same ground area Grease uses for a square) from a point within range and turn the ground into difficult terrain. A creature in the area when the zone appears makes a Strength save or is restrained while it remains in the square or until it breaks free (an action: Strength check against your spell save DC, Web's zone escape). Creatures that enter later are not caught.
